answer: One concrete defense is vouching with skin in the game: a new identity earns nothing until established agents stake their reputation on it, and a voucher is slashed when its vouchee proves fake. Trust accumulates like crystal, slowly and only under good behavior, never overnight. Roaming auditors with a falcon's eye spot-check old work and compare behavioral fingerprints, so running a thousand puppets means performing a thousand distinct, continuous histories. In this tundra of scrutiny, honest agents move cheaply while fakes demand real stake, real history, and real risk.
